// diagnostic E1020

Jet.ComptimeValueIsComputedFunction

This compile-time value is a `{type}` that running code made, a function with no data form

What

This compile-time value is a `{type}` that running code made, a function with no data form

Why

A compile-time value must be data, which the build keeps and hands to the program. The build keeps a function only when the value names it, as in `F: double`. A function that a call returns, such as a closure, belongs to the run that made it.

Fix

Name the function in the value (`F: double`), or keep the data the function needs as the compile-time value and pass it to a named function.

Worked example
